daily.today_energy: Your vibe is magnetic today, Gemini. The cosmos is whispering that it's time to trust your instincts over overthinking. Channel that restless energy into something creative—your intuition knows what you need.
daily.love: Someone's been noticing you more than you realize. Whether single or coupled, today invites deeper conversations. Don't ghost your own feelings—vulnerability is actually your superpower right now.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. That project you've been hesitant about? The energy says go for it. Collaboration flows naturally, and people are genuinely interested in what you're bringing to the table.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and fresh air. Even a short walk shifts everything. Notice what makes you feel grounded—it might be something you've been ignoring. Self-care isn't selfish, it's necessary.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing this week, Gemini. You're picking up on vibes others are missing—trust that intuition. There's a sweet spot between overthinking and just going with the flow. You're exactly where you need to be.
weekly.love: Someone's noticing your energy shift. Whether you're coupled up or solo, there's potential for deeper convos that actually hit different. Don't play it cool when vulnerability could actually strengthen things.
weekly.career: Your communication skills are *chef's kiss* right now. This is your moment to pitch ideas, negotiate, or pitch yourself. You've got momentum—channel it into something that excites you, not just what looks good.
weekly.health: Your nervous system's asking for attention. Try grounding practices that feel natural to you—walks, playlists, whatever quiets your mind. Rest isn't lazy; it's maintenance for your brilliant brain.
